scope: Historical single-variable headless desktop rain observations; source/rendering references in EVO-MAT-READ01-OBSERVATIONS.json; no integration or GPU root-cause claim. Temporary scripts remain local only.

method.injection: Use createSettingsPreviewServer(0, plugins), append only the recorded candidate CSS to src/theme/settings-workspace.css in a Vite pre-load plugin; open settings in ?weather=heavy; sample successive requestAnimationFrame timestamps; return to current controls at sequence ends. No video recording.
method.quantiles: Sorted interval at floor(samples * q), unlike the 8-case observation script which uses floor((samples-1)*q). Short-window values are observations, not comparable performance budgets.

plane.scope: Interleaved desktop rain hypothesis test; default product unchanged; rAF observations only

radius.scope: Desktop rain blur-radius hypothesis test; default product unchanged; rAF observations only

toplayer.scope: Interleaved desktop rain hypothesis test; default product unchanged; rAF observations only
